name: Lauro
source:
A young woodcutter. He has his lost parents at a young age and has grown up with his sister Colette, which in part explains his slight sister complex.

He is hotheaded and has a foul mouth, but is an honest and gentle boy on the inside.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/enigma/]Fruitbat Factory[/url]]
